nse:106830108.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830108.answer: Management did not give specific quarterly guidance for Q2 FY27. In November 2025, management projected FY26 revenue around ₹12,500 crore with about 5% growth the coming year (FY27), average margins around 15% plus, or 12% to 15% for new projects. Q2 FY27's reported 16.5% revenue decline and 8.1% EBITDA margin fall well below these annual ranges.

evidence.quote: We anticipate that this year, we will have revenue of approximately INR 12,500 crores or so. And the coming year also, we should have may be another 5% growth over that
If it is some newer vessels, it may not necessarily be that high. But on an average, we can anticipate around 15% plus margins
But that will not be the case for the new projects coming in, where we are booking the actual value of production. And in that case, we expect that the margins will be around 12% to 15%

nse:106823051.question: What has management said about this on its recent calls?
nse:106823051.answer: Management did not discuss any distrust of intermediate CAs, root CA distrust, or key generation flaws. The closest discussion occurred in the Q4 FY26 call, where management stated that a Google policy change regarding multi-purpose and new root certificates had no impact because existing roots remained trusted while new roots were queued.

evidence.quote: Our new roots have been submitted some time back

So, nothing stops for us because our existing roots are already trusted on Google and we basically have a transition period where the existing roots will continue to work until the new roots are accepted by Google
So, there is really no impact as such

nse:106830133.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106830133.answer: Management did not discuss this on its last two calls.

nse:106818788.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106818788.answer: Management did not provide explicit forward-looking guidance numbers for revenue or margins for Q2 FY27. However, they expressed an aspirational goal of reaching 16% to 17% EBIT margins over time. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, reported revenue was ₹4,663.9 crore (up 30.3% YoY) and EBIT margin was 15%.

evidence.quote: We achieved a healthy revenue growth of 7.8% quarter-on-quarter and 20% year-on-year delivering USD 487.6 million in Q2 FY27
The EBIT margin for the quarter came in at 15%, translating to an EBIT growth of 1.6% quarter-on-quarter and 19.5% year-on-year
Q2 FY27 revenue stood at USD 487.6 million, registering a year-on-year growth of 20%. In rupee terms, it translates to Rs.46,639 million, a growth of 30.3% year-on-year

nse:106829089.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106829089.answer: Management did not provide explicit quantitative guidance for Q2 FY27 revenue or margins. However, on the Q1 FY27 call in August 2026, they noted that Q1 gaming revenue grew 14% YoY to INR 275 crores with a 19.5% EBITDA margin, driven by scaled user acquisition. The reported Q2 FY27 revenue of 803.1 crore and EBITDA margin of 14.1% reflect continued top-line growth and stable profitability.

evidence.quote: In Q1 FY27, our Gaming segment revenue grew by 14% year-on-year to INR 275 crores
EBITDA reached INR 54 crores, resulting in an EBITDA margin of 19.5%

nse:106823393.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106823393.answer: Management said in October 2026 that food delivery margins are expected to remain flattish over the next 1 or 2 years as they reinvest in growth. This matches the reported Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin of 3.1%, showing a stable trend compared to 1.8% a year ago.

evidence.quote: Directionally, we want to maintain margins broadly and reinvest in growth as much as it makes sense to continue to drive the growth upwards
It's hard to project or comment on margin trajectory every quarter but broadly, over the next 1 or 2 years, we expect the margins to remain flattish

nse:106810133.question: What has management said about debt, leverage and its credit profile?
nse:106810133.answer: Management stated that core infrastructure net external debt is around INR 45,000 crores, backed by a regulatory asset base under $4 billion. For metals, materials, and mining, net external debt is about $2 billion against $6 billion in operating assets. Core infra leverage is guided to remain in the 3.5x to 4.5x range (at 3.9x currently), with conservative leverage kept for mining.

evidence.quote: for example, in core infra, which is platform, we have a net external debt of, say, INR45,000 crores, which is about just under $5 billion. Against that, the regulatory asset base itself is just under $4 billion.

the metals, materials and mining, we have a net external debt of about $2 billion, against where we call our operating assets, which are roughly around about $6 billion. So we keep a low or very conservative leverage profile on the metal, materials and mining side,
our core infra will track the core infra. So we guide to that in the core infra while we are growing, we will be closer to the 3.5 to 4.5 range.

nse:106805308.question: What has management said on recent calls about leadership, succession or this role?
nse:106805308.answer: Management announced that the RBI approved Mr. Anup Bagchi as Managing Director and CEO for three years starting October 27, 2026, replacing Mr. Sashidhar Jagdishan. This was communicated during the Q2 FY27 earnings call in October 2026.

evidence.quote: I'm really grateful to the Board for the trust placed in me as MD and CEO

nse:106819733.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106819733.answer: Management stated in October 2026 that Persistent Systems plans to raise USD 1.25 billion through both debt and equity as part of its long-term financing strategy for the Nagarro acquisition. Of this, USD 450 million will come from equity, qualified institutional placement, equity-linked instruments like FCCB, or a combination, with shareholder approval received on October 5, 2026.

evidence.quote: As a part of this long-term financing strategy, we will be raising USD 1.25 billion in terms of both debt and equity
Out of this, USD 450 million will be raised through equity, qualified institutional placement or equity-linked instruments like FCCB or combination of similar instruments
We have received the shareholder approval for the above funding mix at the Extraordinary General Meeting held on October 5th

nse:106831929.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106831929.answer: Management stated in recent calls that Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper, and Ganga Expressway are expected to add over ₹3,000 crores to EBITDA post-stabilization (stated in Q4 and Q3 FY26 calls). In Q2 FY27, revenue grew 13% QoQ to ₹37,215.6 crore (and 75.1% YoY to ₹37,215.6 crore), and profit before tax rose 248.4% QoQ to ₹2,002 crore, while EBITDA margin was 14.8% against 15.6% a year ago.

evidence.quote: In the next fiscal year, AEL is set to unlock EBITDA from Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper and Ganga Expressway, which are expected to add over INR3,000 crores EBITDA to AEL
In the coming period, first, AEL will unlock EBITDA from Navi Mumbai, Kutch Copper and Ganga Expressway. Post stabilization, these 3 assets are expected to add well over INR3,000 crores to EBITDA
